title: Glowing skateboard
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='deck' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff5fb0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#b0297a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#7dffd4'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#19c99a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wheel' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffe14a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e0a400'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow halo under deck -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='40' ry='7' fill='#19c99a' opacity='0.35'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='26' ry='4.5' fill='#7dffd4' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- trucks -->
  <rect x='24' y='66' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#c9a9ff'/>
  <rect x='66' y='66' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#c9a9ff'/>
  <rect x='22' y='64' width='14' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e6d4ff'/>

  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='78' r='7' fill='url(#wheel)'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='78' r='3' fill='#fff6c0'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='78' r='7' fill='url(#wheel)'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='78' r='3' fill='#fff6c0'/>

  <!-- deck -->
  <path d='M8 62 Q8 54 18 54 L82 54 Q92 54 92 62 Q92 68 82 68 L18 68 Q8 68 8 62 Z' fill='url(#deck)'/>
  <!-- deck top highlight -->
  <path d='M12 58 Q12 56 20 56 L80 56 Q88 56 88 58 Q88 60 80 60 L20 60 Q12 60 12 58 Z' fill='#ff9ed0'/>

  <!-- glowing stripes along the side -->
  <rect x='20' y='64' width='60' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='65.5' r='2' fill='#d8fff2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='65.5' r='2' fill='#d8fff2'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='65.5' r='2' fill='#d8fff2'/>

  <!-- glowing grip deco on top -->
  <path d='M26 57 L34 57 L30 60 Z' fill='#7dffd4'/>
  <path d='M66 57 L74 57 L70 60 Z' fill='#7dffd4'/>
  <rect x='44' y='56' width='12' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#d8fff2'/>
</svg>
